title: Wall Street dips at open, Apple weighs | Creative Tips
text:
Wall Street dips at open, Apple weighs January 29, 2018 0 
(Reuters) – Wall Road dipped on the open on Monday, easing from document ranges hit final week, as a fall in Apple’s ( AAPL.O ) shares weighed on the three main indexes. 
The Dow Jones Industrial Common .DJI fell 49.26 factors, or zero.19 p.c, to 26,567.45. The S&P 500 .SPX misplaced 7.6 factors, or zero.26 p.c, to 2,865.27. The Nasdaq Composite .IXIC dropped 23.86 factors, or zero.32 p.c, to 7,481.92. Reporting by Tanya Agrawal; Enhancing by Savio D’Souza
